copy.tagline: 集成 Google Chat 消息通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将应用消息发送到 Google Chat 频道。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Google Chat messaging into your application
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send app messages to a Google Chat channel.

howto.what: 应用这个技能会在项目中加入 Google Chat 适配器：复制适配器文件、注册模块、安装固定版本依赖，然后构建并运行集成测试。使用前还需手动在 Google Cloud 创建服务账号并配置公网回调地址，否则无法接收消息。
howto.when: 当你要求加入 Google Chat 频道、接入 Google Chat，或说要用 Chat SDK 集成时。

say.text: 添加 Google Chat 频道
say.note: 会去安装依赖并跑测试。

say.text: 用 Chat SDK 接入 Google Chat

howto.what_en: Adds Google Chat support to the project: copies the adapter, registers it, installs a pinned dependency, then builds and runs the integration test. Manual Google Cloud credential setup and a public webhook URL are still required before messages can be received.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add Google Chat as a channel, integrate Google Chat, or use Chat SDK integration.
